name: Tanz im August 2026
description: Tanz im August is one of the most important festivals of contemporary dance and the largest gathering of dance theater in Europe. The 38th edition, presented by HAU Hebbel am Ufer under artistic director Ricardo Carmona, features 19 productions with 54 performances across 11 venues, including 3 world premieres, 6 German premieres and 4 Berlin co-productions. The festival presents dance as a political force that generates interaction and impact, inviting audiences to find orientation together in times of instability.
